title: A Robust Learning-Based Method for the Helmholtz Equation in Dissipative Media and Complex Domains
summary: To mitigate pollution effects in high-frequency Helmholtz problems, Learning-based Numerical Methods (LbNM) reconstruct solution operators using complete systems of exact solutions. However, the previously used fundamental-solution (FS) basis suffers from instability in dissipative media and requires sensitive geometric tuning. In this paper, we propose a robust alternative using a Bessel basis (BB).
